positions.name: MissingIdHandlingRequirement
positions.frame: What should the pipeline do when a memory arrives with no explicit id, so that the prod missing-id failure does not recur?
positions.why: Both statements read toward the same question. src-1 names the prod failure pattern this sample reproduces: a ## level heading with no id field. src-2 sets the bar for handling it: the pipeline must not crash and must produce a valid slug. One describes the failing case and the other the required behaviour, so they cohere as a single frame. The dimensional reads differ in mood: src-1 is present-tense and realis, src-2 is future-directed and irrealis. That is a difference of role, not a tension in the frame.
